critical_code_review_comments: MedEditPanel.jsx is well-scoped (~150 lines). ComboInput correctly preserves free text (value === typed) and never forces selection — passes safety principle.
GET /api/internal/rx/suggest returns ranked drug + per-drug fields (strengths/forms/routes/sigs) with correct source labels (patient/physician/catalog) — verified live in network capture.
SendPrescription.ensureDrugSuggest correctly memoises per drug key to avoid refetch storms.

Minor UX polish suggestion (non-blocking): ComboInput dropdown could group by source (patient/physician/catalog) with subtle headers for even faster visual scan; today the source tag is a right-side chip which works well.
